说明: 翻译质量评测语料。50 条全部取自用户真机取词记录（tools\日志\历史取词记录\ + release\v0.4.8.1\logs\）与 tools\素材\行真值.json，不是编的句子。原文用「干净版」而不是 OCR 输出 —— 本表只量翻译，OCR 的错另由 L_行 指标负责；少量条目把 OCR 明显错字（oRDER→ORDER、Chose→Choose）改回，改了什么写在「注」里。全部 ≤400 字，不触发 LongTextTranslator 的切段，避免把分段因素混进来。判分口径同 RULE 6：N 条里错几条。

items.text: BACK
items.注: 已知老印象说会译成「后退」，首次评测实测为「返回」，已订正。

items.注: 两词复合名词。

items.注: 同上。

items.text: Standard Bicycle
items.注: 日常物件，看是否会过度游戏化。

items.text: Increases ranged and thrown ATK
items.注: 游戏 buff 描述，RPG 术语密集。

items.text: Improves movement speed while carrying small weights
items.注: 同上一句的断行另一半，凑成完整句。

items.text: Provides reduced visibility to enemies, bonus melee stealth attack damage, and additional vision while
items.注: 首次评测判错项。长 buff 描述，修饰关系（reduced visibility to enemies）易读反。

items.text: Use the Block command without holding a shield to
items.注: 操作说明，原文被框选截断（真机常态）。

items.text: CLICK and DRAG with left mouse button to create new walls or rooms. Confirm any changes by clicking ORDER at the bottom right.
items.注: 两句连写、混大小写，接近 200 字内的长样本。

items.text: The menu where old character files are presented under the "Continue" button.
items.注: 首次评测判错项。定语从句套两层（where + under）。

items.text: Armor Class in Barony directly prevents damage from physical attacks. Every creature's base armor class is equal to its Constitution score. The base calculation for damage taken after AC is relatively simple:
items.注: 约 200 字，带公式引言，仍不触发切段。

items.text: 31 hours 11 mins remaining!
items.注: 时间数字串。

items.text: Ошибка 404 (страница не найдена): файл "config.txt" не найден — попробуйте /help?id=123
items.注: 俄文报错，混拉丁文件名和 URL。

items.text: Файл занимает 2,5 МБ и загружается 30 секунд при 60 FPS
items.注: 俄文带数字和单位，小数逗号要转成点。

items.text: Sortie using the current setup.
items.注: 短操作句。

items.text: HP Attack Defense Movement Magic
items.注: 五个属性名并列，中间没标点，看是否会被误连成句。

items.text: Weakness weak to Perforation weak to Ice
items.注: 关键词重复（weak to ×2），看是否只翻一次。

items.text: All elemental damage is increased by 25% when wearing this amulet
items.注: 带百分号的装备描述。

items.text: Learning a language takes time but it is worth the effort.
items.注: 普通英文长句，非游戏语境。

items.text: Machine translation converts text from one language to another.
items.注: 定义句。

items.text: Machine translation is a type of computational linguistics where sentences are translated from one language to another.
items.注: 同一条的加长版，where 引导定语从句。

items.text: Optical character recognition converts images of text into editable text.
items.注: 定义句。

items.text: Optical character recognition converts images of text into editable text. It is used to read scanned documents automatically.
items.注: 两句，第二句用代词 It 指代前句主语。

items.text: This is deliberately low contrast text on a grey background.
items.注: 简单句对照基线。

items.text: This is deliberately low contrast text on a grey background, which is one of the hardest cases for any recognition engine.
items.注: 同一条加 which 从属句。

items.text: Small printed text on a paper-like background is the case that trips up most recognition engines.
items.注: 主语很长（Small printed text on a paper-like background），后面才接谓语。

items.text: This paragraph is deliberately rendered in a small font size, because small text is where optical character recognition usually struggles the most.
items.注: 约 150 字，because + where 两级从句。

items.text: Use parts to research new equipment. Researched equipment will appear for sale in shops.
items.注: 两句，第二句主语是前句宾语的变体（equipment）。

items.text: Your name may appear around GitHub where you contribute or are mentioned. You can remove it at any time.
items.注: 两句，where 从句 + 代词 it 回指 your name。

items.text: Delete account Once you delete your account, there is no going back. Please be certain.
items.注: 标题和正文黏在一起，Once 从句。

items.text: Public email Select a verified email to display
items.注: 字段名 + 提示语黏在一起，无标点。

items.text: Public profile Account Appearance Accessibility Notifications
items.注: 侧边栏菜单项并列，无标点，最易被当句子翻。

items.text: SSH and GPG keys Credentials Organizations Enterprises Moderation
items.注: 同上，第一条本身含 and。

items.text: Billing and licensing Emails Password and authentication Sessions SSH and GPG keys Credentials Organizations Enterprises Moderation

items.text: GitHub Copilot Write better code with AI
items.注: 品牌名 + 广告语，无标点分隔。

items.text: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog
items.注: 标准全字母句，做稳定性对照。

items.注: 标题 + 正文黏连，全大写开头接全大写动词。

items.text: Below are a few example calculations showing how damage is reduced with various ACs and armor effectiveness values.

items.注: DLC 名并列，每个名字本身含 and，三段 and 叠加。
